note_doctrine: Strictly ADDITIVE on v2: every v2 instruction is preserved verbatim. The four new sections (EXIGENCES DE SORTIE STRUCTURÉE, EXEMPLE POSITIF, EXEMPLE NÉGATIF, INTERDITS) extend the contract without removing any v2 requirement. The four new output fields (rubrique_incriminee_cells, rubriques_innocentees_cells, rubriques_indeterminees_cells, causal_attributions) are REQUIRED in the v3 output_schema; the Pydantic side accepts them as optional with default [] / None for backward compat during the v2→v3 transition window. After v3 promotion, the guard becomes operative on real Gemini outputs (currently dormant — A.1+A.2.2 catch hallucinations only when the structured fields are populated, which v2 does not emit).
